tasks.AnalyzeCriticalPointsAndBoundaries: Analyze both the critical points found from setting the partial derivatives to zero and the values of the function on the boundaries.
tasks.CheckBoundaryConditions: Evaluate the function at the boundary conditions for x and y within [-1, 1].
tasks.FindPartialDerivatives: Calculate the partial derivatives of f(x,y) with respect to x and y.
tasks.SetPartialDerivativesToZero: Set the calculated partial derivatives equal to zero to find critical points.
